title: DOCOM CertificateFollowUpUpdated event (v1)
description: Event emitted when the Part III follow-up records on a TRACES DOCOM certificate are observed or republished. Certificate aggregate; subType is DOCOM. data is the full set of follow-up records for one certificate, keyed to it by data.certificateIdentifier. Separate from CertificateUpdated because TRACES appends follow-up records without reissuing the certificate.
